title: "Why this?" influence query -- measured context spans overlapping a selected answer range
description: A derived, read-only projection over one run's persisted clozn.context_answer_influence.v1 measurement (run['influence_map']), scoped to a caller-selected half-open Unicode-code-point range of the recorded answer. Never starts a new measurement, never calls a model or engine, never mutates the run. Every link.effect / delta_nats / abs_delta_nats / clears_floor / evidence_state is copied UNCHANGED from the source artifact's own Link objects -- this projection reorders and filters, it never recomputes or reinterprets a measurement. A link with evidence_state=observed and clears_floor=false was measured, not irrelevant -- see clozn.context_answer_influence.v1's own caveat, which this projection does not weaken. measurement.state distinguishes 'no measurement was ever attempted' (not_measured) from 'a measurement exists but nothing in this range cleared the floor' (available with zero causally_supported_links) -- these must never collapse into the same shape. This is controlled intervention evidence over one recorded continuation: never a claim that a source caused the answer, was relevant, was correct, or that the model reasoned from it, and never a percentage attribution.

start.description: The requested range's start offset, echoed back unchanged.

basis_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact recorded answer text (run['response']) this range was resolved against. Present whenever that text is known, even when measurement itself is unavailable -- absent only when the answer text could not be read at all (e.g. redacted).

answer_span_ids.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id values for every measured answer span overlapping [start, end). Present only when measurement.state is 'available'.

state.description: 'not_measured': no influence map was ever attached to this run, or it cannot be trusted at all (wrong schema, or fails its own schema). 'unavailable': a persisted artifact exists but it, or the recorded answer text needed to resolve this range, cannot honestly be used right now (status=unavailable, redacted text, or a stale/drifted answer hash). 'error': the persisted artifact itself recorded status=error. 'available': the measurement was consulted and reconciled with this run's CURRENT answer text -- links may still be empty, which is a distinct, honest finding from any non-available state.

reason.description: A stable, machine-readable reason, taken from the persisted artifact's own error code when one exists. Present on every non-available state; absent when state=available.

artifact_sha256.description: The source clozn.context_answer_influence.v1 artifact's own artifact_sha256, unchanged.

method.description: An unchanged copy of the source artifact's method object, including its persistent honesty caveat. Never re-derived.

thresholds.description: An unchanged copy of the source artifact's thresholds object (the floor a link's abs_delta_nats must clear to be evidence_state=causally_supported).

source_span_id.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id for the measured context span.

answer_span_id.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id for the measured answer span this link scores.

effect.description: Copied verbatim from the source Link -- never re-derived from the sign of delta_nats by this module.

delta_nats.description: Copied verbatim from the source Link. Licenses a claim about this exact intervention on this exact recorded continuation only.

clears_floor.description: Copied verbatim. False is NOT evidence the source was irrelevant -- see evidence_state.

evidence_state.description: Copied verbatim from the source Link -- never reinterpreted.

native.description: The underlying influence-map native identifiers/indices, retained for traceability. Not the canonical public identity -- source_span_id/answer_span_id are.

selected_answer_spans.description: How many measured answer spans overlapped [start, end).

measured_links.description: Total links overlapping the selected range, BEFORE limit is applied. May exceed len(links) when the result was truncated.

returned_links.description: len(links) -- how many of measured_links this response actually carries after limit.
